name: gpux macOS fast-mode perf and memory, part 3
objective: Keep lowering CPU and memory on native macOS in both fast modes: cheaper reuse of retained views (splice key lists, layout verification), smaller per-element structs, scene teardown, shaping setup, layout node memory.

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.
